config.title: Build product catalog API with search

intro.title: Build product catalog API with search
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple product catalog API using Node.js that allows you to list products and search them by name. You will learn how to set up a basic HTTP server, define API endpoints, and handle incoming requests. The core programming concepts include using JavaScript objects to model data and implementing search logic with array methods. You'll work with Node.js's built-in 'http' module to create a server and respond with JSON data, giving you a practical introduction to backend web development.
intro.usecase: Product catalog APIs with search functionality are foundational to virtually every e-commerce platform and content management system. When you search for products on Amazon, filter items by category on Etsy, or browse inventory on a retail store's website, you're interacting with this exact pattern. As a Node.js developer, you'll implement these APIs to power search interfaces, category filters, and product listing pages that handle thousands of requests daily. Mastering this skill enables you to build scalable backend systems for online marketplaces, inventory management dashboards, and content discovery platforms.

objectives: Construct a Node.js server with Express to handle HTTP requests
Implement API endpoints for retrieving and filtering product data
Configure middleware to parse incoming JSON request bodies
Integrate search functionality to filter products by query parameters
Initialize and manipulate an in-memory data store for product catalog operations
Apply error handling to manage invalid requests and missing resources
Render structured JSON responses with appropriate HTTP status codes

steps.expectedOutcome: The request handler will now filter products by name when a 'search' query parameter is provided.
